sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the presence-only combinedShearBendingEffect string check with a bounded comparison that requires combinedShearAndBendingDemand and plasticStrength quantity operands and enforces demand <= plastic strength. Retain midspanPlasticCollapseLoad on each structuralMember reached through hasStructuralMember, and require the plastic-collapse-mechanism evidence defining that load. Encode the side-structure/longitudinal-local-frame applicability and relevant controlled location rather than applying the rule indiscriminately to every ship; do not use the supplied convenience applicability boolean.
